capabilities: Type Chinese via a built-in Pinyin IME with candidate selection
Toggle Chinese and English with a configurable key (Shift by default)
Type full-width Chinese punctuation in Chinese mode
Download and update a large offline dictionary with checksum verification
Run diagnostic commands and save redacted key-trace reports into the vault
extras: The full ~26 MB dictionary (GPL-3.0 data compiled from rime-ice) is downloaded at runtime from npmmirror with npmjs fallback; the plugin itself is AGPL-3.0-or-later. The README recommends disabling it on Mac and when using the iPad on-screen keyboard to avoid Shift conflicts with other input methods.
motivation: The author only wanted to write Chinese with a keyboard on iPad and "ended up writing an input method first", calling it a personal workaround they hope becomes unnecessary.
problem: Typing Chinese in Obsidian on an iPad with a hardware keyboard is laggy because of the system Pinyin IME, and the plugin author says no fix outside Obsidian is possible.

relations.evidence: 拼音引擎用 RIME，通过 My RIME 的 WebAssembly 构建。

summary: Built-in Pinyin input method for the editor that bypasses the laggy system Chinese IME when typing with an iPad hardware keyboard.
